headline: PriceSmart Plans First Wholesale Club in Cartagena by 2027
summary: U.S. membership warehouse retailer PriceSmart plans to build its 11th Colombian location in Cartagena's Serena del Mar area, targeting an opening in late 2027 or early 2028.
why: Expansion into new commercial markets allows warehouse retailers to scale membership bases and drive international revenue growth.

impacts.name: PriceSmart
impacts.why: The retailer plans to expand its geographic footprint with a new store opening.
